tokens.name: color-crown-gold
tokens.usage: Elevated Calm gold (leadership, light). Coaching, retreat and premium print; behind `brand-gold`. Fill only: ink text (`color-rooted-ink`) on it, never white.

tokens.name: color-rooted-evergreen
tokens.usage: Elevated Calm evergreen (grounding, depth). The primary brand fill behind `brand-primary`; `text-inverse` reads on it. A dark ground for `mbw-submark-social-on-dark.svg` (social and digital only).

tokens.name: color-sovereign-plum
tokens.usage: Elevated Calm plum (feminine authority). Secondary fill behind `brand-secondary` and link text behind `text-link`; `text-inverse` reads on it.

tokens.name: color-terra-rose
tokens.usage: Elevated Calm rose (warmth, humanity). Rose badges and warm accents; `text-inverse` on it holds 3:1 only, so keep text on it 19px bold or larger, or short uppercase labels.

tokens.name: color-sage-renewal
tokens.usage: Elevated Calm sage (renewal, wellness). Success fills (`state-success`) and avatar initials; `text-inverse` on it is below 4.5:1 (source value kept), so text on it is large or bold.

tokens.name: color-radiant-crown
tokens.usage: Radiant Energy gold for social, launches and CTAs. Fill only, with `color-rooted-ink` text.

tokens.name: color-deep-grove
tokens.usage: Radiant Energy evergreen; the hover state of `brand-primary` and the dark ground for on-grove logo colorways and `mbw-submark-social-on-dark.svg` (social and digital only).

tokens.name: color-power-plum
tokens.usage: Radiant Energy plum; the hover state of `brand-secondary` and link hover (`text-link-hover`).

tokens.name: color-ember-rose
tokens.usage: Radiant Energy rose for social and launch accents. Fill only; text on it is large or bold.

tokens.name: color-renewal-olive
tokens.usage: Radiant Energy olive for social and launch accents. Fill only, with `color-rooted-ink` text.

tokens.name: color-ivory-light
tokens.usage: Warm neutral end of the palette: the page ground (`surface-page`) and inverse text (`text-inverse`). Use it instead of white for full-bleed fields.

tokens.name: color-rooted-ink
tokens.usage: Dark neutral end of the palette: headings (`text-heading`), the footer and inverse surfaces (`surface-inverse`), and text on gold fills.

tokens.name: color-orchid-mist
tokens.usage: Accent tint, sparing use: soft badges and highlight panels (`surface-accent-soft`), with `color-shadow-plum` text.

tokens.name: color-shadow-plum
tokens.usage: Accent dark plum: text on `color-orchid-mist` and `surface-accent-soft`.

tokens.name: color-morning-sky
tokens.usage: Accent tint, sparing use: info alerts (`state-info`), with dark text.

tokens.name: color-sunlit-cream
tokens.usage: Accent tint: sunken panels (`surface-sunken`), warning alerts and hover grounds for ghost and outline buttons.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Card surfaces (`surface-card`) only; full-bleed fields stay `color-ivory-light`.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background: full-bleed warm ivory, not white.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, modals and switch knobs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed panels, hover ground of ghost and outline buttons, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark sections and the site footer; set text on it in `text-inverse`.

tokens.name: surface-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis highlight panels and the `soft` badge, with `color-shadow-plum` text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on `surface-card` (4.7:1). On `surface-page` it measures 4.49:1, a hair under 4.5:1 (source value kept), so use it there for 14px+ text; keep it off `surface-sunken` (3.9:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline for inputs, ghost buttons, dividers and tables; decorative only (below 3:1), so a field also needs its label.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasis borders and the outline button.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, checked controls and focus borders; `text-inverse` on it.

tokens.name: brand-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `brand-primary`: shift to the Radiant tone, never a new hue.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: High-visibility launch CTAs and the script accent word; `color-rooted-ink` text on it.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: Success alerts and confirmations; pair with a title word, not color alone.

tokens.name: state-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings; pair with a title word, not color alone.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Errors only: field borders and error text on `surface-card` (5.7:1); brick red, never decorative. On the error alert's pink tint it is 4.25:1, so keep alert copy at the alert's sizes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraphs and long-form UI copy, in `text-body`.
styles.sample: You are not broken; we help you build the support you actually need.

styles.name: body-italic
styles.usage: Gentle asides, quotes and pull-out lines within body copy.
styles.sample: For gentle asides, quotes, and pull-out lines.

styles.name: body-semibold
styles.sample: For inline emphasis inside a paragraph.

styles.name: caps-line
styles.usage: Bold caps claim line, as "MOM BOSS" in the wordmark; `tracking-wider`.

styles.name: script-accent
styles.usage: Parisienne accent: one soft word under a caps line, in `brand-gold`. Never body copy, buttons or full sentences.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, tabs, switches and avatars-as-pills.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting swatches, tiles and small surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Default `Card` and hover state of soft tiles.

textSize.note: The type scale as CSS variables, used by the components.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: Labels, small buttons and secondary copy (15px).

tokens.name: tracking-wider
tokens.usage: The caps "MOM BOSS" line and eyebrows.
